records.section: PAINT ch03 — „Das Piratenschiff" · Unit 3: Piraten (g1-u03) / §3 · Bewitchment concept
records.requirementOrFinding: OSWIN scribbled over the ship's muster roll: now no pirate knows what he's got. The crew stomps about arguing — one insists he „have got two foots", the parrots screech wrong claims, and the cook guards a treasure chest he can't describe. `goalDe`: „Sag den Piraten, was sie (nicht) haben — wer sich wieder kennt, hört auf zu streiten." `whyDe`: „Jeder richtige Satz näht das Musterbuch der Mannschaft wieder zusammen." Restoration: corrected pirates strike proud poses on deck; the roll's pages re-stitch.

records.requirementOrFinding: - **p1 „Der Hafen der Tintensee"** (~64×22): docks + gangway. First screen: coin trail arcs through the crane's ring line (trail-as-tutor). Rowboat rides across the swell (G3 + the wave bob). Parrot fend-offs debut: parrot dives → fist shoo → the encounter task is the CLAIM FIX („He has got one beard — hasn't he?" style, built at task pass). Cages: being #2 (coin trail), teased #5 (crow's-nest barrel, visible from the dock, needs p3 height).

records.section: PAINT ch03 — „Das Piratenschiff" · Unit 3: Piraten (g1-u03) / §5 · Phase-chain layout
records.requirementOrFinding: - **p2 „Unter Deck"** (~72×24): the hold + brig + galley. **Set-piece: DIE BILGE STEIGT** — OSWIN's scribble jammed the pumps; the bilge waterline rises in pulses (G5 trigger-driven), you climb the cargo shelves ahead of it; punching each pump handle (trigger) freezes it (release valve = the taught counter). The cook blocks the galley with have-you/has-he questions (riff). Person cage: **ILVY in the brig, on-path**. Klecks door on the galley sail-cloth. Cages: being #3 (trail into the bilge alcove — reachable between pulses; anti-law 8: bait never over a kill zone).

records.section: PAINT ch03 — „Das Piratenschiff" · Unit 3: Piraten (g1-u03) / §5 · Phase-chain layout
records.requirementOrFinding: - **p3 „Die Takelage"** (~56×30, TALL): the rigging — the chapter's vertical exam. Ring-swing chains mast to mast, sail trampolines, boom crushers, rat swarms on the yards. **The DESCRIBE-THE-PIRATE beat (riff, verbatim design):** freed ILVY meets you at the mast base with the captain's PICTURE — a produced has-got/hasn't-got description round about the picture (tall/short, big/small, short/long adjectives woven per the riff) — before the arena unlocks. Cages: being #1 (coin trail), **later-verb #4** on a wind-held platform (needs ch04 hover — visible tease).

sourceSpecificAssessment: Frühes Kapitelblatt erhält Piraten-/Körperteil-/have-got-Absicht, wird durch S083–090 konkretisiert. Ringgabe am Kran statt Fibel an Tür, ein Ring statt unspielbarer gleichhoher Kette, 26 statt alter 22/24 Feldzeilen. Sichtbare muster-roll-Restitution, Bilge, hüpfende Kanonenkugeln, Trost und produktive Bildbeschreibung bleiben offene Zusagen, nicht durch Grundriss erledigt. cook/sea/treasure sind im Riff genannt, aber nicht automatisch geprüfte Unit-Vokabeln; hat hat eigene Korpusgrenze S090. Frühe Bonus-Wiederholbarkeit/Erstattung/Sticker weichen von späterem Einmalvertrag ab und werden als Versionswechsel bewahrt. Namenssignatur verletzt spätere Geheimhaltung; nicht als zu rettender Auslieferungstext behandeln.
